_comment: The Uptime Kuma 2.x setup of US-015 (plan M4.8), as data: what docs/runbooks/monitoring.md step 7 has you create in the UI, and what infra/monitoring/kuma-check.sh verifies through Kuma's /metrics. Uptime Kuma 2 has no supported configuration-as-code import, so the creation is by hand (about ten minutes); this file is the single list. <DOMAIN>, <VM_IP>, <WAHA_HOST>, <SESSION> and the numbers are filled in the UI; no secret is written here (the WAHA key and the SMTP password are typed into Kuma only).

notifications.notes: Straight to WAHA on this box, so it does not depend on the app VM (AC-P4). <ALERT_SESSION> is a session that stays WORKING when the pool's sessions are down. The Owner must have written to that number once, so WhatsApp lets it answer (docs/runbooks/alerts.md).
Host, port, security, user, password, from and to are entered in Kuma. Use an SMTP account that is NOT the app's, so one outage cannot silence both.

monitors.notes: The deep health of the public app: PostgreSQL, the worker heartbeat (at most 3 minutes old) and Valkey. Caddy answers it to MONITOR_ALLOWED_CIDRS only: this box's address.
Needs this box's address in ADMIN_ALLOWED_CIDRS (everyone else gets a 404 there).
The front the players use, through Caddy and the load balancer, from outside.
UPTIME_KUMA_PUSH_URL of /etc/ebooktrivia/worker.env. The worker pushes every 60 s while PostgreSQL and Valkey answer; no push for 120 s is DOWN, so a killed worker alerts within 3 minutes (AC-P12).

UPTIME_KUMA_ALERTS_PUSH_URL (same Kuma host). The worker reports DOWN while a critical alert has stayed unsent for 5 minutes (the relay or its channels are broken), UP otherwise; the message holds a count and alert kinds only. Kuma notifies on a change of state only, which is why this is the second route and the relay (apps/worker/src/alert-relay.ts) the first.
The VM itself (firewalld answers ICMP echo). With the port monitor below, a powered-off VM turns both red: the VM-down drill (AC-P4).
Caddy's listener, without a Host header.

One monitor per pool session; a READ-ONLY GET of WAHA's own status (never a change to the session's configuration). A session that leaves WORKING alerts by WhatsApp (from the alert session) and e-mail within 3 minutes, independent of the worker (D3, AC-P12).
GlitchTip on this box. If /_health/ is not served by the pinned release, point it at the login page.
